name: York Mountain
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Central Coast AVA in California's San Luis Obispo County, west of Paso Robles. The York family established vineyards and a winery here in 1882.
